subject: Request: trial material onboarding & MAP for BrightCart evaluation
messages:
From: Elena Park <elena@brightcart.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 1 Jul 2026 16:20:00 +0000
Subject: Request: trial dataset exchange & mutual action plan

Hi Marcus,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at BrightCart is excited to run a short POC against Redwood to validate latency and prompt-pack fidelity on our checkout summarization tests. We have a small seed dataset (approx. 12k anonymized transactions) and a prompt pack that mirrors our regression suite.

Would Redwood be open to the following?
- Sign a short MAP (mutual action plan) that outlines scope, timelines, and acceptance criteria.
- Provide ephemeral onboarding access to a staging endpoint (no persistent copies outside the environment).
- Accept our seed dataset + promptpack for a 3-week evaluation.

Constraints from our side: no re-sharing outside of the evaluation team, data must be deleted 30 days after POC close, and we need clear audit logs of who accessed the dataset. Our security team can provide the dataset as a zip and a CSV manifest.

If this is straightforward, can we aim to have the MAP signed and dataset exchanged by July 8 so we can close the POC by July 29?

Attached: brightcart_eval_manifest.csv (manifest only — dataset will be shared once MAP is agreed).

Best,
Elena
Elena Park
Head of ML Ops | BrightCart AI
elena@brightcart.ai
+1 415 555 0192

Hi Elena — appreciate the clear ask. Yes, we can do an ephemeral onramp for the seed dataset and prompt pack; a short MAP makes sense. High level we recommend:

1) 7/8 MAP signed -> team completes legal & security checklist
2) 7/9-7/11 onboarding: dataset ingest to a dedicated staging lane (ephemeral)
3) 7/12-7/26 POC run / acceptance tests (you run regression suite, we capture token & latency metrics)
4) 7/29 final acceptance and either transition to dedicated capacity or teardown

A few asks from our side:
- Please confirm the dataset has been de-identified (no unencrypted PII) or indicate fields that need hashing.
- Can BrightCart share SOC2 or a short security posture PDF for our internal review?
- We’ll propose an MAP template and a short access agreement (ephemeral access + deletion 30d post-close).

I’ve dropped a draft MAP template in case your legal wants to iterate: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Onboard-Playbook-Redwood (redwood_map_template_link.txt attached).

Would you prefer a quick 30-min sync tomorrow to align stakeholders?

Thanks,
Marcus

Elena — great, thanks for sending the seed and prompt pack. Confirming next steps and MAP milestones below: 

1) 7/8: Redwood sends MAP (DocuSign link) for signature. Once countersigned by BrightCart we’ll issue short-lived S3 credentials for upload (1 hour validity).
2) 7/9-7/11: Ingest to dedicated staging lane (ephemeral). We will enable per-request audit logs, and the data will not be exported outside the staging environment.
3) 7/12-7/26: POC run window. Acceptance criterion: BrightCart regression pass rate >= 92% on promptpack and mean generation latency < 230ms for 95th percentile. Both parties will collect logs and token-level cost reports.
4) 7/29: Close meeting. Options: 1) transition to Dedicated capacity with contract; 2) teardown and verified deletion.

We confirm Redwood’s commitments: automated deletion 30 days after close, access logs retained for 90 days (read-only archive), and no training of customer-provided datasets outside the agreed POC. I’ll send the DocuSign MAP link in a separate email to legal contacts.

Drive playbook for onboarding: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Onboard-Playbook-Redwood
